title: Selva Wire Schema
description: Messages and runtime state the plugin, the Selva server and the browser exchange. Never saved into a .gh, so it carries no schemaVersion: the fixtures in fixtures/wire/ pin it instead.

DiscoveredInput.description: Input parameter discovered in Grasshopper document

acceptedFormats.description: File extensions the parameter accepts (e.g. ['.png', '.svg'] for an image input, geometry formats for a file input). Used to seed the file widget's accepted-formats default.

groupName.description: Nickname of the directly enclosing Grasshopper group, if any. Used by the builder to offer 'Add by GH group' bulk import.

DiscoveredOutput.description: Output component discovered in Grasshopper document

type.description: Output display type in UI: 'text' for text output, 'number' for numeric output, 'file' for downloadable files, 'chart' for rendered charts (e.g. Plotly), 'dynamicValueList' for computed value-list options routed back into a dynamic value list input

targetInputId.description: For 'dynamicValueList' outputs: the instance GUID (paramId) of the DynamicValueList input that this output's computed options populate.

groupName.description: Nickname of the directly enclosing Grasshopper group, if any. Used by the builder to offer 'Add by GH group' bulk import.

DiscoveredParameters.description: Collection of input and output parameters discovered in the current Grasshopper document

inputs.description: List of input parameters available for UI building

outputs.description: List of output components available for UI building

SolveEvent.description: One live event from a running solve. The header is fixed; `payload` is shaped by `type`. `type` is an open string so a new event kind is additive on every transport (unknown kinds pass through).

seq.description: Per-solve, monotonic from 1. Lets a consumer drop late or duplicate delivery.

type.description: Event kind: solveStarted, solveEnded, diagnostic, progress, valueListUpdated, ...

SolveDiagnostic.description: One runtime message a solve raised. Also the payload of a `diagnostic` event.

message.description: What the author wrote, transport decoration stripped.

source.description: Nickname of the component that raised it.

isGate.description: Raised by a Selva Message component: the author chose to say this. Only these interrupt the user.

SolveOutcome.description: The plugin's verdict on a finished solve. Decided once at SolutionEnd; the local bridge and Rhino.Compute only carry it.

blocked.description: A Message component raised an error, or the solve was aborted. The outputs are not a result.

aborted.description: The solve was stopped before it finished.

SolveStartedPayload.description: Payload of a `solveStarted` event. Empty today.

ProgressPayload.description: Payload of a `progress` event. Coalesced per `source`: only the newest per source matters.

source.description: What is progressing; one bar per source.

nextFraction.description: 0..1: where `fraction` will be when the running step ends. With `stepMs`, lets a host fill the bar across the step instead of jumping at its end.

stepMs.description: How long the running step took last time, in milliseconds. Absent before it has been timed.

ValidationIssueMessage.description: Validation warning or error for a parameter

severity.description: warning = can still load, error = cannot load

SelvaAccount.description: Who the plugin is signed in to Selva as, for the web UI's account row. Never carries the token: the plugin holds it.

origin.description: The instance this account is for, normalised to an origin. Absent until the user names one.

host.description: The origin's host as shown to the user: an internationalised name in punycode, so a look-alike domain is visible.

knownOrigins.description: Instances this machine has signed in to before.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working, ISO 8601.

extraScopes.description: What a pasted key can do beyond reading and uploading, e.g. `write:all`. Empty for a browser sign-in.

storage.description: keychain: kept in the OS credential store across Rhino sessions. memory: lost when Rhino closes.

message.description: Why the last sign-in or sign-out ended the way it did, when it needs saying.

SelvaTargets.description: Where the open definition can go: a new definition in one of these projects, or a new version of a definition Selva already has. `suggestion` is the definition this file was last uploaded to on this instance, when the user can still edit it.

projects.description: Projects the user can create definitions in.

matches.description: Other editable definitions uploaded from the same Grasshopper document.

blockedReason.description: Why nothing can be uploaded right now.

linkedVersionNumber.description: The version this file last uploaded. Absent for a match found by document id.

newerVersions.description: Versions uploaded after linkedVersionNumber, newest first.

SelvaDefinitionDefaults.description: Filled from the saved UI schema.

SelvaUploadFile.description: What would be uploaded: the whole definition as it is on the canvas, internalised data and script source included.

SelvaUploadRequest.description: The web UI's upload choice. newDefinition reads projectId and the metadata; newVersion reads definitionGuid and changeNote.

makeLive.description: Point the definition's live channel at the new version. Off, it lands as the draft.

stage.description: uploading covers Selva checking the file on Rhino.Compute, which happens before it answers.

live.description: The new version is what users of the definition get.

url.description: The definition's page on the instance.
